0022600196.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East, 0-2 at home, six straight losses) host the Philadelphia 76ers (8-2, 1st in the East and 1st in the Atlantic) in the Bulls' 9th game of the season. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain), and Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture). Philadelphia beat Chicago 126-107 in their last meeting, in Philadelphia on November 2, leaving the Bulls trailing 0-1 this season, though Chicago won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
